meta.subject: add 1 forgeted fix for csc read image jump address wrap

en.summary: Fixes the CBUF dual-read address pair for CSC image jump-wrap reads so the hardware fetches current plus wrapped-next, not predecessor plus current.
why_it_counts: The patch changes DUT read-address generation in the CBUF data path.
The new logic uses the explicit wrapped next address input instead of deriving a stale predecessor/current pair.
The bug directly changes which buffer entries are read during image jump handling.
evidence: The only touched file is vmod/nvdla/cbuf/NV_NVDLA_cbuf.v.
sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0 changes from a conditional current-1 expression to the current address itself.
sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1 changes from the current address to sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr.
The surrounding code shows these are the two SRAM read addresses used when sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_en requests a second entry.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A dual-entry image-read path in a circular buffer must request the current entry together with the explicit wrapped-next entry when a read jump crosses the logical boundary. If the hardware instead derives the pair as predecessor plus current, the two-entry window is shifted and wrap cases fetch the wrong data even though the dual-read enable still fires.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Image-mode read-jump cases where the consumer requests a second entry and that second entry is provided through an explicit wrapped-next address path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Break the second-address generation so the dual-read pair is formed as predecessor/current instead of current/wrapped-next.
portability_notes: Target the logic that forms two read addresses from one image-read request, not unrelated buffer-bank decode.
The injected fault should only affect the special second-entry path so ordinary single-entry reads remain correct.
If another DUT uses a modulo pointer rather than an explicit next-address signal, map the fault to the wraparound computation that chooses the companion address.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that emits two buffer read addresses for a single image-read or jump request.
When the second-entry flag is asserted, replace the first address with a predecessor/current-relative derivation or keep it stale instead of using the requested current address directly.
Make the second address reuse the current address rather than the explicitly computed wrapped-next address, while leaving the dual-read enable intact.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CBUF dual-read decode for CSC image jump reads
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix rewrites sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0/sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1 so the two-read pair becomes current plus sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr whenever the second-read path is active.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_cbuf.v, restore sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0 to the old conditional current-1 expression and restore sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1 to sc2buf_dat_rd_addr instead of sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Jump-wrap image reads fetch the wrong pair of CBUF entries, producing off-by-one or wraparound corruption in CSC input data.
evidence_for_injection: The commit touches only the two address wires that feed the dual-read SRAM decode.
The second-address path is explicitly gated by sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_en.
The fix consumes sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr, indicating the bug was in wrap-aware companion-address selection.
notes: This is a localized reverse patch with a clear trigger: image jump reads that request two entries.
A reusable injection on another DUT should preserve normal one-entry reads and only corrupt the dual-entry wrap case.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CSC 图像 jump-wrap 读取时 CBUF 的双读地址配对，使硬件读取“当前项 + 回绕后的下一项”，而不是“前一项 + 当前项”。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CBUF 数据路径中的 DUT 读地址生成逻辑。
新逻辑使用显式的回绕后 next 地址输入，而不是继续推导出陈旧的前一项/当前项组合。
该缺陷会直接改变图像 jump 处理期间实际读取的 buffer entry。
evidence: sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0 从条件式的 current-1 表达式改成了当前地址本身。
sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1 从当前地址改成了 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr。
周围代码表明这两个信号就是 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_en 触发第二次读取时使用的两路 SRAM 读地址。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在环形 buffer 的双项图像读取路径里，当 read jump 跨越逻辑边界时，硬件必须读取“当前项 + 显式计算出的回绕后下一项”。如果错误地把这对地址构造成“前一项 + 当前项”，那么虽然双读使能仍然有效，但两项窗口会整体偏移，回绕场景就会抓到错误数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 环形缓冲区双项读取地址生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 图像模式的 read jump 需要第二个 entry，且第二个 entry 通过显式的回绕后 next 地址路径给出时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 破坏第二地址生成逻辑，使双读地址对退化为“前一项/当前项”，而不是“当前项/回绕后下一项”。
portability_notes: 应定位到一次图像读取如何形成两个 buffer 读地址的逻辑，而不是其他 bank decode 逻辑。
注入后的故障应只影响特殊的第二 entry 路径，使普通单 entry 读取仍然正确。
如果另一套 DUT 用的是模指针而不是显式 next 地址信号，就把故障映射到回绕伴随地址的计算逻辑上。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到一次图像读取或 jump 请求如何发出两个 buffer 读地址的逻辑。
在第二 entry 标志有效时，把第一地址改回基于前一项/相对地址的推导，或保留旧值，而不是直接使用当前请求地址。
让第二地址复用当前地址，而不是使用显式计算出的回绕后 next 地址，同时保留双读使能。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CBUF 中面向 CSC 图像 jump 读取的双读地址解码逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复重写了 sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0/sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1，使第二读路径激活时两次读取变成“当前地址 + sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr”。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_cbuf.v 中，把 sc2buf_dat_rd_addr0 恢复成旧的条件式 current-1 表达式，并把 sc2buf_dat_rd_addr1 恢复为 sc2buf_dat_rd_addr，而不是 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 发生 jump-wrap 的图像读取会抓取错误的一对 CBUF entry，导致 CSC 输入数据出现 off-by-one 或回绕型损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交只修改了喂给双读 SRAM 解码的两个地址线。
第二地址路径明确受 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_en 控制。
修复版开始使用 sc2buf_dat_rd_next1_addr，说明原始缺陷就在回绕感知的伴随地址选择上。
notes: 这是一个局部且可直接反向注入的补丁，触发条件很明确：请求双 entry 的图像 jump 读取。
在其他 DUT 上做可复用注入时，应保持普通单 entry 读取正确，只破坏双 entry 回绕场景。
